summary: A slow push into a still. The honest answer when a shot must stay pixel-faithful.
doc:
Use whenever a shot contains something a generative model will wreck: readable signage, a real person's face, a plate of food that must not morph, a logo.

This rig invents nothing. The frame closes in on a photograph and that is all. It was written because LTX grew hands around a plate of lettuce on every seed tried - the empty-frame clause and a negative did not stop it, because something has to act in a generated shot and a plate of food starves the agency slot. A push on the real photograph has no such problem.

Pair it with a borrowed ambience bed so the sound does not drop out at the cut.

win_w.doc: window width in plate px at zoom 1.

win_h.doc: window height in plate px at zoom 1.

zoom_end.doc: zoom at the last frame. 1.06-1.12 reads as alive without drawing attention.

drift_px.doc: lateral drift across the move. A little stops it feeling mechanical.

ease.doc: 1 = smooth in and out, 0 = dead linear.

slow_reveal.note: Barely-there 9% push. The default for food and faces.

closer.note: Firmer 18% push with a touch of drift.
